tasks.description: Ship the Phase 1 distribution: Homebrew formula (tap), cargo-dist release workflow producing mac/linux binaries plus .deb/AppImage and a Windows installer; wire `rein-app update` (newest rein tag, release notes, confirm or --yes) and `rein-app rollback` (swap .rein.prev-*, re-run rein doctor) onto E-5; implement the Windows WslLauncher (wsl --status, install Ubuntu if absent, run Linux rein-app inside WSL, open Windows Terminal into the tmux session) behind a Shell trait with stubbed unit tests for no-WSL, no-distro, ready, per .ai/blueprints/distribution.md §Components 7-8, §API, §Rollback Plan, §Test Plan.

Rework the LayoutWriter and `rein-app rollback` from the whole-home staging swap to the in-place per-file sync of the manifest's mirrored directories (D-011): open only paths under layout.mirrored plus VERSION (everything else in $HOME/.rein is never read, copied, written or deleted); preflight refusals before any write (symlinked home, symlinked mirrored dir or target component, held lock); pure SyncPlan {ship, prune} with operator_owned protected inside mirrored dirs; snapshot of the release payload only to $HOME/.rein.prev-<oldver>/{tree/,VERSION,layout.json} (0700, temp-then-rename, N=2); sync with hooks last, temp file beside the target + manifest mode + rename, then prune; VERSION last; on failure restore from the snapshot through a fault seam; rollback snapshots the current tree, syncs the newest earlier snapshot back, removes it, re-runs rein doctor and restores code only. Remove the staging swap, the carry-over copies and OrphanedPrevious. Per .ai/blueprints/distribution.md §Components 3 (steps a–f) and 7, §Data Model (Snapshot, SyncPlan), §Security trust boundary 2, §Rollback Plan. Acceptance: §Test Plan cases "Untouched outside the mirror", "Sync failure", "Snapshot", "Rollback", "Refusals" plus the existing upgrade-semantics test green in cargo test --workspace on all three CI targets. Tier 3: security_engineer review before commit. No release tag before this is on master.
tasks.summary: In-place per-file sync of mirrored dirs, payload-only snapshots, code-only rollback (1ac3f78, d1c62af); ARCH/TESTS/SEC pass; hosted CI green x3

tasks.description: Make `rein-app install --version` optional: with no version given, resolve the newest rein tag through the same resolver `update` uses (crates/rein-release/src/latest.rs — GitHub releases API, metadata only; the release is still verified and version-bound) and install it; an unreachable release server exits 11 as in `update`. Per .ai/blueprints/distribution.md §Components 7 and §API table row `install [--version X.Y.Z]` (D-012 ruling 4). Acceptance: stubbed-Http tests for install with no version (installs the newest tag), with --version (unchanged), and offline (exit 11); cargo test --workspace green.
tasks.summary: `install` without --version installs the newest tag via the update resolver; offline exit 11 (ded24eb); hosted CI green x3

tasks.description: Write the layout-equality test against install-rein.sh: from a rein checkout at tag T run install-rein.sh into temp HOME A, build the artifact with rein's own generator `rein release manifest`, sign it with our throwaway test minisign key, run `rein-app install --version T` from the fixture server into temp HOME B, and assert `diff -r A B` is empty except the documented exceptions (a retired MCP server's directory is the one expected until rein rules who removes it — report any other diff to the Architect rather than adjusting the writer). EXTERNALLY BLOCKED: do not start until rein P-50 ships `rein release manifest` (the Architect will say so in a handoff) — if this task auto-opens after E-7 while rein still lacks the generator, leave it OPEN and skip it. Per .ai/blueprints/distribution.md §Test Plan "Layout equality" and §E-## Task Breakdown E-9 (D-012 ruling 3). Acceptance: the test runs in CI when a rein checkout is available (gated on an env var naming it) and is green.

Add the owner guard to `rein-app install`, `update` and `rollback` (unix): right after the install lock is created, read the run's uid from the lock file's own metadata (no unsafe, no new dependency) and refuse — naming the path, writing nothing, releasing the lock — when it differs from the owner of $HOME, of $HOME/.rein when it exists, or (rollback) of the snapshot root or its layout.json; keep the comparison a pure function over uids. Also print one line when a populated home with no semver VERSION is updated without a snapshot (rollback unavailable for that update). Per .ai/blueprints/distribution.md §Components 3 steps a and c, §Security trust boundary 2 (D-013). Acceptance: §Test Plan "Owner guard" (pure-function unit cases; one CLI test per command with the mismatch injected, no root needed; no lock left behind) and "No-snapshot notice" green in cargo test --workspace on all three CI targets (the guard compiles to a no-op on Windows). Tier 3: security_engineer review before commit.
tasks.summary: Owner guard (uid from lock handle, $HOME via symlink, fail closed) + no-snapshot notice (5b8bc6b); ARCH/TESTS/SEC pass; hosted CI green x3

tasks.description: Make the owner guard a compile-time precondition in rein-release (follows E-10, which is DONE): change `owner_guard` to return a proof value that has no public constructor and borrows the `InstallLock`, and require a reference to it in every lock-held function that writes (`install_tree_locked`, `install_tree_with_faults`, rollback's lock-held writer), updating `install_cmd`, `rollback_tree_with` and the tests; add a `compile_fail` doctest showing a lock-held writer cannot be called without it. Tighten the tests: each CLI refusal test (install, update, rollback) asserts the offending path appears in the error, and the Linux test that uses the real `/tmp` as a foreign-owned home skips when `/tmp/.rein.lock` already exists and never shares that path with a concurrently running test. Per .ai/blueprints/distribution.md §Components 3 step a (type-level precondition), §Test Plan "Owner guard" (E-11 additions), D-013 addendum. Acceptance: cargo test --workspace (doctests included) green on all three CI targets; no behaviour change for a correctly guarded run. Tier 3: security_engineer review before commit.
tasks.summary: OwnerChecked proof (private, lock-borrowed, bound to the held lock's home) required by every lock-held writer; compile_fail doctests; refusal tests assert path (3e466c0, a8332e9); CI green x3
